loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Marty vs Biff jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous scene of a card match in a cinematic 80s movie style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Marty McFly and Biff Tannen are seated properly and facing each other across a chrome-trimmed table in a 1950s diner booth, playing a game of Magic. Marty looks nervous and worried, while Biff has a smug, aggressive smirk. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering card layout is displayed: rows of fantasy cards with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees to indicate they are tapped, next to a chocolate milkshake in a tall glass. Outside the large window, the silver DeLorean with its gull-wing door open is parked on the street. In the background, patrons of the diner watch. Warm neon diner lighting. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
